disposition.target: P2 message catalogue (detcheck owner of MSG-P5-006)
disposition.change: Align the P2 use of MSG-P5-006 to the meaning in section 14 of this story: the notice type has no document type in force (FSD P5). Eight messages are listed in section 14.
disposition.note: Story lists eight messages. MSG-P5-006 clash sits in the P2 catalogue, which is not in this chunk; no story edit made.

disposition.change: Publish the base and route of the five template operations under /api/recovery/comms/v1/admin/templates, the SCR-33 composite route, the freshness-stamp data product and the withdrawal generation hold point.
disposition.note: Moved template operations and screen route belong to P6 and the registry. Requests, responses, states and messages stay unchanged; no story edit in this chunk.

disposition.target: RWB-P3-E1018-CON (rwb-case contract) and Ownership Map v1
disposition.change: Publish the task-raise operation of rwb-case, or the event that creates a task, and record it in the ownership map for the two tasks raised by the notice flow.
disposition.note: Ownership Map v1 holds only task read and update. The task-raise path must be published before the app story can use it.

disposition.target: TSD P6 v2 (T3.1) and legacy RWB-E1-052 field list
disposition.change: Give the party reference its own field ID and keep person_key as the business key of the notice, then correct the module specification or the legacy field list.
disposition.note: DF-LEG-030 is party_id in one source and person_key in the other. Data steward decision; no story edit.

disposition.target: RWB-P6-E1052-CON and legacy RWB-E1-052 (cross-service notice path)
disposition.change: Route generation through POST /cases/{caseId}/notices on P6, read ACE facts and the stale-batch signal through P1's data-product contract, store the PDF through P5, keep the merge snapshot in P6 as references only.
disposition.note: Target path and stale-batch signal are set by the P6 contract and P1 data product. Legacy values and messages stay unchanged.

disposition.target: TSD P3 v3 (recovery_case) and the data dictionary
disposition.change: Add the seven notice fact columns to recovery_case and load the notice timeline event codes into LOV-LEDGER-EVENT. Data steward to issue field IDs in the next dictionary version.
disposition.note: Migration V1052_1 for these columns sits in a story section not in this chunk; the story edit must be applied there.

disposition.change: Contract dependencies row now names RWB-P5-E1052-CON operation POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents with version not specified.
disposition.note: Request shape, answer fields and 2 s behaviour are not specified in the source documents (GAP-1079). Contract publication is a separate step.

disposition.change: Name the merge snapshot store, a snapshot table or a column on the local decision record, and publish it in the next physical-schema version.
disposition.note: No source names the snapshot table. Data steward decision; no story edit in this chunk.

disposition.change: Publish the NoticeRequest and Notice schemas with required flags and the NoticeGenerated payload, and confirm them with the app stories of this key.
disposition.note: No property list or required flags exist in the sources. Field list is set by the rwb-comms API specification v5.

disposition.change: Publish one error row per condition for API-P6-001: withdrawn-template hold answered with notice state Held, repeat with different key answered 409, missing field answered 422.
disposition.note: Error code per refusal condition is not fixed in the sources. Solution architect to publish in the rwb-comms contract; no story edit.
